summary: Solid test suite with 23 comprehensive unit tests covering glob pattern matching, rule loading, label assignment, file loading, and CLI functionality. Tests verify error handling, priority conflict resolution, multiple independent labels, and end-to-end workflow execution via act. Well-organized into unit tests (test_label_assigner.py), workflow structure validation (test_workflow_structure.py), and integration harness (run_act_tests.py). Strengths include clear test names, good use of fixtures and helpers, thorough error scenario coverage, and validation of exact expected outputs in act integration. Minor gaps: some glob pattern edge cases (empty patterns, deep nesting, `?` combinations) not explicitly tested; fixture files and workflow file not visible for verification; no explicit test for default priority=0 or rules with matching priority ties. Design is clean with good separation of concerns. Would catch most regressions, though workflow file correctness cannot be verified from provided code.
